name: Vigil
install: sudo python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --ignore-installed -r requirements.lock -r requirements-dev.txt && npm ci --prefix clients/web && npm ci --prefix services/agent
start: bash -lc 'sudo service docker start || true; set -euo pipefail; for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; if [ "$i" = 60 ]; then echo "docker daemon did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis bifrost; for i in $(seq 1 60); do if docker exec deeptempo-postgres pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U deeptempo -d deeptempo_soc >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker exec deeptempo-redis redis-cli ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q PONG; then break; fi; if [ "$i" = 60 ]; then echo "postgres/redis did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8080/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; if [ "$i" = 60 ]; then echo "bifrost did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; PSQL="docker exec deeptempo-postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U deeptempo -d postgres"; $PSQL -q -c "DO \$d\$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = \$q\$vigil\$q\$) THEN CREATE ROLE vigil LOGIN PASSWORD \$q\$vigil\$q\$; END IF; END \$d\$;"; $PSQL -tAq -c "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = \$q\$vigil_test\$q\$" | grep -q 1 || $PSQL -q -c "CREATE DATABASE vigil_test OWNER vigil"; DB_STRICT_SCHEMA=true python -c "from core.storage.connection import init_database; init_database()"; for f in 19_agent_ledger 31_agent_ledger_hash_chain 20_agent_directives 21_agent_run_leases; do docker exec deeptempo-postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -U deeptempo -d deeptempo_soc -f /db-init/$f.sql >/dev/null; done; bash scripts/agent_testdb.sh'
